representation_paths.memory_component: compressed historical trajectories and expired in-session segments

evidence.paraphrase: A shared trajectory-to-latent compressor converts retrieved historical trajectories and expired current-session segments into compact tokens woven into the live policy context.

As the session advances, expired trajectory prefixes are compressed by the trained module into new latent working-memory blocks. For Mem-W, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of compressed historical trajectories and expired in-session segments.

derived.hybrid_relation: Procedural and working memories share the same latent-token interface.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): The compressor/writer is trained offline and frozen at inference; only memory state is updated during use, so this is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
